title: Preface
publication: Discours de la cause de la pesanteur
author: Christiaan Huygens
full_title: Discours de la cause de la pesanteur, in Traité de la lumière. Où sont expliquées les causes de ce qui luy arrive dans la reflexion, & dans la refraction. Et particulierement dans l'etrange refraction du cristal d'Islande. Avec un Discours de la cause de la pesanteur
source: The preface to Huygens's *Discours de la cause de la pesanteur*, printed with his *Traité de la lumière* (Leiden: Pierre vander Aa, 1690).
transcribed_from: the [page images](https://archive.org/details/bub_gb_X9PKaZlChggC) of a copy digitised by Google Books, on the Internet Archive.
summary: Huygens sets out what may count as an explanation of gravity: not inherent qualities, appetites, a heavy air or immaterial spirits, but, as Descartes saw, only bodies without qualities and their motions. He offers his own hypothesis as open to doubt, but as the only one likely to be true within sound philosophy.
